title: Whey: what it means for your plan
standfirst: Which of our plan rules this ingredient turns on, and what that does not tell you.

spans.text: Whey, the liquid or dried protein fraction left over from cheese-making, used as a protein and dairy ingredient.
Why it is in your food
Manufacturers use whey as a base food/protein and it is of animal origin.
Our rules read whey as a milk ingredient.
Our scorer looks for whey when the plans on this page are on. If those plans are off, your score does not change. This is how the app reads a label. It is not a claim about health.
Labels do not all use the same word for this. Below is every spelling we watch for. Some come from other languages, because a pack made for another country prints its own.
One word on a label can cover more than one thing. A plan may also turn on how much is in the food, which this page cannot see. Read the pack when it matters.
